description:
## [1.5.0](https://github.com/patapon888/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.5.0) (2026-11-20)

### Daydream
* The app catalog (store.json and its icons) now comes from this repository
* New XR category in discovery, with Wolvic

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Renames the app from "Classic" in the launcher.

options.description: The name shown under the app icon.

patches.name: Classic mode layout
patches.description: Arranges the game modes in the main menu like the original iPad version. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.

patches.name: Disable Play Games sign-in
patches.description: Stops the game from signing in to Google Play Games and showing its pop-up at launch.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Removes the game's network access, which also removes the data consent pop-up, and turns off analytics.

patches.name: Fix Diamond Mine background
patches.description: Stops the Diamond Mine wood background from being stretched on wide screens. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.

patches.name: Fix text formatting
patches.description: Fixes texts that skip a word or show "(null)", such as the title of a won badge. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.

patches.name: Hide profile id
patches.description: Removes the EA account number shown after the player name in the records. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.

patches.name: Language setting
patches.description: Adds a language choice in Android settings (Apps > Bejeweled > Language, Android 13+). Restart the game after changing it.

patches.name: Remove Play Games buttons
patches.description: Hides the Google Play Games buttons from the menus. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.

patches.name: Remove boosters
patches.description: Removes the paid boosts from every mode, the Diamond Mine "use a time boost and continue" offer and the "no more moves, use a mixer" offer. The hint stays, centered in the tray. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.

patches.name: Remove purchases and ads
patches.description: Removes ads, the store, promotional pop-ups and the paid continue offers after a game over.

patches.name: Unlock game modes
patches.description: Unlocks Poker, Lightning and Butterflies, removing their limited free plays. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.

patches.name: Daydream Everywhere (YouTube VR)
patches.description: Runs YouTube VR edge to edge with its background, signed in through MicroG RE.

patches.name: Daydream Everywhere (Daydream)
patches.description: Runs Daydream on any arm64 phone without root.

patches.name: Daydream Everywhere (Keyboard)
patches.description: Lets the Daydream keyboard run re-signed, and adds Swiss layouts.

patches.name: Daydream Everywhere (VR Services)
patches.description: Runs Google VR Services on any arm64 phone without root.

patches.name: Enable Prime
patches.description: Enable Nova Launcher Prime and app locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches.name: Open in bubble
patches.description: Requires root. Adds an "Open in bubble" long-press option that opens apps as Android 17 app bubbles. Can be toggled in Settings > Look & feel > Long-press Menu. Only for Nova Launcher 9.0.0 on Android 16+.
